title: Choose the learning target before the architecture
description: Change the required output, label coverage, and latency budget. The fit model shows why the narrower prediction objective or the broader distributional objective is the better place to start.
notice: Fit scores are transparent teaching heuristics, not accuracy forecasts. Sparse labels help only when the chosen objective can actually use unlabeled structure; supervised Naive Bayes still needs class labels. Validate every recommendation with representative data, task metrics, and production constraints.
